title: A finitely generated field extension becomes separably generated after finite purely inseparable extensions
statement: Let $K/k$ be a finitely generated field extension [def-pc-field-extension] (i.e. $K=k(a_1,\dots,a_n)$ for finitely many $a_1,\dots,a_n\in K$). Then there exist a field $K'$ with a field homomorphism $K\to K'$, and a subfield $k'\subseteq K'$ containing the image of $k$ under $k\to K\to K'$, such that $k'/k$ and $K'/K$ are finite purely inseparable extensions [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension] and $K'$ is separably generated over $k'$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (1): there is a transcendence basis $(x_i)_{i\in I}$ of $K'/k'$ with $K'/k'(x_i;i\in I)$ separable algebraic. In other words there is a commutative square of field extensions $k\to k'\to K'$, $k\to K\to K'$ with $k'/k$, $K'/K$ finite purely inseparable and $K'/k'$ separably generated.

proof.text: Lift k and K to Type (max u v) with ULift. The down/up algebra equivalences preserve essential finite type, finite dimensionality and pure inseparability; this is only a universe adjustment, with actual constructed algebras.
Finite generation gives a finite transcendence basis s. Its adjoin has algebraic extension to K; essential finite type over this intermediate field makes that extension finite.

Use strong induction on Field.finInsepDegree k(s) K, generalized over all same-universe fields and finite bases with finite algebraic extension. When the degree is one, Mathlib isSeparable_iff_finInsepDegree_eq_one gives a separating basis, so take identity extensions. Otherwise the one-step construction supplies finite purely inseparable extensions and a finite basis with strictly smaller degree; apply the induction hypothesis to those data.

Compose both finite purely inseparable towers using Module.Finite.trans and IsPurelyInseparable.trans. Define the composite algebra maps explicitly as RingHom.comp.toAlgebra. The two scalar-tower equalities prove that the final square commutes. Compose with the initial ULift isomorphisms to produce fields in exactly Type (max u v) with the original statement unchanged.

split_report.summary: Statement checked against Stacks 04KM and kept. The 'details omitted' (existence of k') is written out: c_j = h_j(x)/g_j(x)^p with h_j = f_j g_j^{p-1}, k' = k(s^{1/p}) for the coefficients s of the h_j, inside an algebraic closure of K. Also written out what the source leaves implicit: k'/k and L/K finite purely inseparable (subfield of elements with p-th power in F), x^{1/p} a transcendence basis of L/k' (Frobenius twist of a relation), K_sep ⊆ L_sep, beta = alpha' by injectivity of Frobenius, and the degree drop [L:L_sep] ≤ [K:K_sep(beta)] < [K:K_sep] (new leaf: degree of a compositum, Mathlib adjoin_rank_le_of_isAlgebraic_right; new leaf: tower law). The source's claim 'L_sep is the compositum of K_sep and k'(x^{1/p})' is true but not needed and is not used. New unsplit node: Fields 031V (p-th root lemma), not in Mathlib. Composition of finite purely inseparable extensions is a new leaf (09HG, IsPurelyInseparable.trans + Module.Finite.trans).
